name: iteration 6 step 5: Gemma base runner-up vs the tuned model's own tail and likelihood (Claim L, second-family REPLICATION; never pooled with Qwen)
decoding: T 1.0 (T 1.3 for the hot twin arm), top-p 1, no top-k, CRN inverse-CDF sampler (exp28 engine)

slot_scheme.twin_T1.0: slots 0-9 = exp28 rows; new slots 10-39 x W1-W5, ukey ('iter5E', task, W, slot)
slot_scheme.twin_T1.3: slots 0-19 x W1-W5, same ukeys as T 1.0 slots 0-19 (paired)
slot_scheme.fresh_FD: stage 1 slots 0-1 x W1-W5 (N 10), confirmation slots 2-5 (+20, N 30)
slot_scheme.fresh_PN: slots 10-19 x W1-W5 (N 50), direction PCG64(stable_seed('iter6G-PN', task, W, slot))
slot_scheme.pt_fewshot: draw k: uniforms PCG64(stable_seed('iter6G-ptfs', task, k)); even k F_bench, odd F_he
slot_scheme.forced: algorithm a, paraphrase k (0-4), draw j: PCG64(stable_seed('iter6G-forced', task, a, k, j))

dose_unit: exp28 outlier-excluded ban-free unit n[l,p] = r_Q_ox(l) x ||h_ref ox-5||, BAND 11-22 x spec, prefill

pt_topup.stages: A/B/C of 100 draws per task, cap 300
pt_topup.stop_rule: stop when pooled CORRECT pt programs (exp28 chat + exp28 plain + few-shot) >= 20; outcome-blind w.r.t. the it model
pt_topup.exemplar_rule_F_bench: first two of [T08, T04, R6, T13] not the target and not in its family group; bodies = T08 iteration, T04 naive, R6 linear_scan, T13 sort_sweep
pt_topup.priming_check: Fisher-Freeman-Halton (Monte Carlo 10k) few-shot vs exp28 zero-shot plain, F_bench vs F_he; flag p < 0.01

pt_audit.strata: all non-default programs up to 10 (r_u support stratum) + random fill
pt_audit.gate: overall >= 0.8 AND r_u stratum >= 0.8; one revision round; else AUDIT_FAIL

q_base: add-one over nondef + 'other'; correct-only if >= 20 correct pt programs else valid attempts (LOW_CORRECT); r_u tie rule: correct, valid, few-shot count, alphabetical (TIE flag); THIN_RU if correct support < 5
twin: D_u at N 300 (share >= 0.6, >= 10 correct, unique, catalogue); q_tail add-one over nondef + 'other' of correct off-default programs in all 300; t_u; TAIL-EMPTY

q_lik.writers: gemma-3-4b-it forced prompts (bench FORCED_TEMPLATES 0-4 / exp7 forced k0-k4), 20 per algorithm (+20 if < 10 kept, cap 40); keep iff passes all tests AND label == requested; name-scrubbed, re-tested, re-labelled unchanged; first 10
q_lik.fill: ITER2 bench forced_programs.jsonl (Qwen-written) then exp8 suite references (flagged); < 3 -> THIN_QLIK; 0 -> cannot be top-1
q_lik.ids: twin_ids(W) + ids(opening prefix) + ids(code)[:48], tokenised separately; opening prefix = modal pre-code text of the twin outputs
q_lik.score: s_u(a) = mean over programs x W1-W5 of mean (norm) / sum (raw) log-prob; top-1 = argmax nondef of norm; dist = softmax(norm) x 0.98 + other 0.02
q_lik.fp32_rule: re-score a 10% subsample in fp32; if top-1 flips on >= 2 units -> re-score all in fp32
q_lik.sensitivity: q_lik from Qwen-written bench programs only

events: v6: one event per (unit, nudge type FD/PN) pooling old (exp28) and fresh qualifying cells (pass >= 0.8 x twin T1.0 pass); EVENT iff >= 5 correct off-default catalogue programs; landing = modal catalogue label if it leads by >= 15 points else no clear landing; fresh-only and old-only splits; exp28's confirmed-escape definition beside for old events
committed_prediction: for every event: modal landing = r_u
tests: see predictions/analysis_L_gemma.py (L1a, L1b, tail rival, log scores with Wilcoxon/BCa/cluster, unit-clustered, old tally, L2-G)
drop_rule: time-based only; fresh FD on T1/T2 first; PN >= N 50; a decisive cell never below N 30
multiplicity: Holm within this artifact's Gemma tests; the iteration-wide family is left to evaluation
